title: The digital paperwork hell: Document Classification AI for clinics and consultancies
body:
Does your administrative team waste hours every morning opening emails, reading messy attachments, and renaming PDFs by hand to save them in the correct folder?

In professional services SMEs (like consultancies, law firms, or medical clinics), clients constantly send documentation: payrolls, scanned IDs, crumpled invoices, or medical reports. The problem is that they send it without a subject line, mixed up, and in unreadable formats. Your employees have to act as "human sorters," opening them one by one, deciphering what they are, checking which client they belong to, and uploading them to the management software. This repetitive, manual work exhausts your staff, causes the loss of critical legal documents, and delays actual service delivery.

The trap of Basic Email Filters

To try and automate this, many companies configure static rules in Outlook or Gmail that filter by the message subject. However, the real client almost never uses the correct subject and often groups an invoice and a legal document in the same PDF. Trying to organize your clients' chaos with rigid email rules is like trying to organize a library using only the color of the book covers.

Our solution: AI Document Classification and Triage Agent

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we turn your inbox into a smart funnel. We train Artificial Intelligence models with computer vision (OCR) and natural language understanding that visually "read" and process attachments just like a human would, connecting them directly to your document management system.

  1. Computer Vision for Documents (Smart OCR): The AI scans invoices, deeds, or medical reports, extracting key data (names, dates, amounts) even if the client has sent a blurry photo or an upside-down PDF.
  2. Automatic Semantic Classification: The model analyzes the text content and categorizes the file autonomously (e.g., "Rental Agreement" vs. "Payroll"), separating combined documents within the same file.
  3. Direct Client Assignment (ERP/CRM): The agent cross-references the extracted ID or name with your database, renaming the file with the company's official nomenclature and saving it in the correct client record.
  4. Missing Documentation Alerts: If the agent detects that a file is incomplete (for example, the back of an ID is missing), it automatically replies to the client requesting the exact file without administrative intervention.

The Real Impact on your Administrative Productivity

  • Administrative Bottleneck Elimination: Your team reclaims up to three hours a day previously lost organizing files, allowing them to attend to more clients and bill for more services.
  • Absolute Document Accuracy: No more lost documents in spam folders or filed in the wrong directories, ensuring impeccable regulatory compliance during any audit.
  • Customer Service Acceleration: By classifying and processing information instantly, your clients' legal or medical procedures begin the same day they send the email, radically improving their satisfaction.
